caveats: AP depends on the positive rate: only the same-cell model difference is interpreted, never absolute AP across groups.
WL2 novelty is a structural-support proxy, not proof about what the network learned.
Test is an exposed comparison set; all numbers are descriptive.

definitions.delta_ap: AP(new model) - AP(W2) recomputed inside the same split x task x novelty group cell (both classes required)
definitions.rank_change: within-task normalized percentile of a true positive in the new model minus W2 (positive = new model ranks it higher)
